# Ingredient lines as recipe sites actually write them.
#
# This is the held-out corpus for the normalization coverage metric (BL-0031).
# It is written the way `recipeIngredient` arrives from a JSON-LD import: a
# quantity, a unit, and item text carrying the adjectives, preparation notes and
# qualifiers a human wrote — NOT tidy canonical names.
#
# METHODOLOGY, so the coverage number means something. This file was committed
# BEFORE any dictionary or normalizer change in BL-0031, and is not edited
# afterwards. Growing coverage therefore has to come from the dictionary and the
# resolver handling text they had not seen, not from rewriting the exam. Adding
# lines later is fine; changing or deleting one to make a number move is not.
#
# Lines beginning with '#' and blank lines are ignored.

# --- Italian / Mediterranean ---
2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 large yellow onion, finely chopped
1 (28-ounce) can crushed tomatoes
1 teaspoon dried oregano
1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
1 pound dried spaghetti
1/2 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
1/4 cup chopped fresh basil
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
8 ounces fresh mozzarella, torn
2 tablespoons unsalted butter
1 cup arborio rice
4 cups low-sodium chicken broth
1/2 cup dry white wine
1 small shallot, minced
2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
1 pound ground beef
1/2 cup whole milk ricotta cheese
1 (14-ounce) can diced tomatoes
2 medium zucchini, sliced
1 large eggplant, cubed
1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted
2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
1 bunch fresh basil leaves
12 ounces penne pasta
1 cup heavy cream
3 ounces prosciutto, thinly sliced
1 teaspoon fennel seeds
2 tablespoons tomato paste

1 cup pico de gallo
